capabilities: Start and stop recording with a rebindable hotkey (Ctrl+S) or a sidebar microphone button
Stream stable transcript segments into the note while speaking via Volcengine big-model ASR
Upload a captured WAV recording to Xiaomi MiMo ASR and insert the final transcript
Store provider credentials (App ID, token, API key) in the vault's plugin data
extras: Desktop-only because authenticated Volcengine WebSocket connections need Node.js networking; states it has no telemetry, ads, or self-update; README includes a full Chinese-language section; manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in speech-to-text, so dictating a note requires a separate app and manual copy-paste.

relations.evidence: Volcengine big-model ASR streams stable transcript segments into the note while you speak.
Xiaomi MiMo ASR uploads a WAV recording after you stop and inserts the final transcript.

requires.name: Volcengine App ID / Access Token or Xiaomi MiMo API Key
Provider ASR usage may be charged per provider pricing

summary: Dictation plugin that records microphone audio on desktop and inserts a transcript at the cursor via Volcengine or Xiaomi MiMo ASR.
